items.question: What is the minimum age for employing a domestic worker in the UAE under Federal Decree Law No. 21 of 2023 on domestic workers?
items.gold: Employing anyone under the age of 18 is prohibited.
items.fact: Domestic worker law prohibits employing anyone under age 18

items.question: Which UAE government ministry handles labour complaints filed by workers and provides legal advice to workers and employers?
items.gold: The Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE).
items.fact: MoHRE handles workers' labour complaints and provides legal advice
